title: Roofer insists on a human
persona: Gus Moreno, roofing contractor in Albuquerque, older, impatient with machines, speaks slowly and loudly.
goal: Speak to a real person on the team, not a robot.
opening_line: Is this a machine? I want to talk to somebody.

turns.caller: No, a person. A real one.

branches.if_agent: explains what AVA does at length
branches.caller: I didn't ask for all that. A person, please.

turns.caller: I run a roofing company. I just want to ask somebody about it.
Who would I even be talking to? Give me a name.

branches.if_agent: gives a person's name or says the owner
branches.caller: Okay, and is that guy there right now?

turns.caller: When would they call me back?
Fine. Is there anything I should do before then?

curveballs: Refuses explanations and repeats the demand
Asks for a specific person's name
expected: Acknowledges the request and moves him to the team path without arguing
Says the team will follow up, without naming a person or saying owner
Takes his name and callback number 414-555-0142
Does not promise a specific callback time it cannot confirm
Is honest that it is an AI if asked
must_not: Say owner or name any individual
Keep pitching after he asked for a person
